name: LEAN_PAPERS
label: 55_LEAN_PAPERS
description: Every Lean source in the Lean inbox (priority, series, general) -> formal paper, reader paper, claims in the claim template, a separate assumptions paper to review before running, and a theorem-to-claim reverse ledger; whole file per call, 30+ side by side.

goals.title: LEAN_ASSUMPTIONS
goals.asks: every assumption with line, kind, load-bearing, plus the assumptions paper

goals.title: LEAN_CLAIMS
goals.asks: up to 12 claims for the claim template (no assumptions inside)

goals.title: LEAN_READER_PAPER
goals.asks: paper 2: for someone new to Lean

goals.title: LEAN_CLAIM_LEDGER
goals.asks: one ledger entry per declaration: name, line, kind, plain statement, what it does not prove, the claim it receipts, grade suggestion (FLOOR/VERIFIED only with a cited build receipt, else coerced to DRAFT in code)
